forum_post: Thirty-one points underwater, she writes, under MY name, like she's got a stopwatch on my soul. You know what else happens in November, Kris? The season ENDS, and I'm gonna be sitting right here at six-and-whatever while you're still printing my point differential like a parking ticket I already paid. Nobody hands me a schedule, nobody hands me a win, I show up every single week and somehow that's the suspicious part. Fine. I'm 'lucky.' Put it on the headstone. And Selina - forty-five points and a spreadsheet Gary built while you stood over his shoulder, very impressive, really - let's see how pretty that offense looks Sunday when it's my defense's turn to be the trap nobody saw coming.
